newsitem.title: USA: U.S. senator plans electric restructuring bill.
newsitem.headline: U.S. senator plans electric restructuring bill.

text.p: Sen. Jim Jeffords, a Vermont Republican, plans to introduce legislation Thursday that will promote alternative energy and clean air as part of the deregulation of the electric industry, an aide to Jeffords said on Tuesday.
The legislation will aim to increase U.S. investments in clean energy, to reduce reliance on oil imports and to reduce the amount of emissions from the production of electricity.

Jeffords scheduled a news conference on Thursday morning to discuss his proposed legislation, which would also require companies that sell electricity to tell consumers the price per unit, generation type and emissions content.
